title: ReleaseWaiver (dated, owned, reversal-conditioned)
$comment: Structural residue of the release.* rules (P0-7). The versioned waiver contract (release.waiver.contract): every field is mandatory because a waiver missing an owner, an expiry, or a reversal condition is a permanent exception, which this artifact exists to prevent. Scanner-outage waivers use the same shape (release.waiver.scanner-outage). autoRenew is pinned false — renewal is a fresh decision on fresh evidence. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

advisoryId.$comment: For a scanner-outage waiver: the outage/staleness incident identifier instead of an advisory.

subjectDigest.$comment: The exact artifact this waiver covers; it does not travel to any other digest (release.evidence.subject-binding).

assessmentRef.$comment: The advisory-assessment.json assessmentId whose classification this waiver rides on; assumption drift there invalidates this waiver early (release.waiver.invalidation).

reversalCondition.$comment: The pre-declared condition under which this waiver is withdrawn.
